question: How are attendant figures positioned relative to the two Aśvins?
premises: The text addresses a brahmin listener.
Figures are placed on the two sides of the Aśvins.
The placement follows a right-and-left order.
inference: Attendant figures are to be placed on the right and left sides of the Aśvins in sequence.
plain_english: O brahmin, on their two sides, to the right and left in order, are placed attendant figures.
